hints.text: This clue's indicator is 'starts' and it's a selection indicator, guiding us to focus on the letters occupying specific positions in some neighbouring fodder.
This clue's fodder is 'by unwrapping mother’s presents'. We'll use these letters (or some of them) to construct our answer, as guided by the clue's indicator(s).

Our definition here is 'Baby shower', and this is an example of an agent noun - nouns that identify the 'doer' of a verb. Cryptic writers use agent nouns in tricky ways; here, we're looking for something that SHOWS a baby - a baby shower!
